prompt: Which operations complete in O(1) time regardless of how many elements the structure holds?
explanation: LPUSH prepends one node at the head of a linked-list-backed structure and HGET addresses one hash field directly, so both are constant time however large the value is. SMEMBERS must serialise every member of the set, and ZADD re-inserts into the sorted ordering, which costs O(log N) per member.

options.text: LPUSH recent:orders onto a list holding two million entries
HGET user:1:profile on a hash with fifty fields
SMEMBERS tags:redis on a set holding one million members
ZADD leaderboard on a sorted set holding one hundred thousand members
